record.oneLiner: A giant duck-billed hadrosaur, among the last non-avian dinosaurs.
record.description: Edmontosaurus was one of the largest hadrosaurids (duck-billed dinosaurs), reaching about 12 m long, with exceptional individuals near 15 m. It lived in Late Cretaceous western North America alongside Triceratops and Tyrannosaurus and was one of the last non-avian dinosaurs. Several specimens preserve extensive skin impressions and possible gut contents.
